appearance.title: B16041 (AIT 27)
appearance.rationale: The edition explicitly identifies B16041 as AIT 27 in section 2.2. Montgomery No. 27 is CBS 16041. Mike’s one-designation ruling applies to this exact museum-scoped concordance; this attaches a source appearance to the existing object and makes no identity merge or reading decision.

texts.content: A later edition is available: Ohad Abudraham, “Bridging the Gaps” (2026; online 2025). It prints a newly collated reading of B16041/AIT27 in the central column of a synoptic edition. Its English translation primarily follows NLI 9467.163 and supplies variants from the parallel bowls. AIT27’s column, personal names and differences need to be mapped explicitly; the whole shared translation must not be presented as a verbatim translation of AIT27. Full private capture and separately indexed original text and translation remain pending.
